method: Built-in image_gen tool; flat coast master with subject variants using the master as a style reference.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: horizontal decorative travel banner illustration for a tasteful travel planning app. Create a CLEAN FLAT VECTOR-STYLE COASTAL LANDSCAPE, panoramic 2.5:1 aspect ratio. Original art direction: very simple, calm contemporary editorial landscape, perfectly smooth flat solid color fills, elegant flowing curves, no outlines, absolutely no texture, no brushstrokes, no gradients, no realistic lighting, no realism. Use ONLY this coherent palette: pale blue-gray sky #D6E4E5, muted seafoam distant hills #8EAFB0, slate-teal middle water #547D87, deep ocean foreground #295361, warm sand #E6D6B9, soft coral #EF9477, warm ivory #FFFDF8. Composition: expansive quiet pale sky occupying upper 40%; a modest coral sun near upper right; gracefully undulating distant coastal hills with a distinctive uneven silhouette rather than generic triangles, three broad smoothly layered sea shapes below. A tiny elegant white sailboat slightly right of center, a gently curving sand shore entering bottom left with ONE well-proportioned palm silhouette leaning over the water, a few restrained thin ivory horizontal water glints. Beautiful spacing and silhouette design are essential. Editorial quality rather than simplistic clipart. Every object is coherent, crisp and carefully proportioned. Broad forms must remain recognizable in a shallow 1200x480 banner and in tiny previews. Avoid visual clutter, heavy detail, toy-looking mountains, repeated symbols, a huge sun, shadows, watercolor, grain, photographs, text, captions, borders or mockups. Exactly one finished full-bleed image, no contact sheet.
